notes:
1. 修复 WebDAV 连接测试未验证下载和清理权限的问题，换设备或清空缓存后会准确提示云端读取失败。[#17](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/17)
2. 支持直接选择一个或多个存档文件，备份、恢复和同步只处理选中的文件。[#18](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/18)
3. 保留旧备份与同步包的规则映射，编辑存档规则后仍可安全恢复历史文件。[#18](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/18)
4. Fixed WebDAV connection tests so download and cleanup permissions are checked, with clear cloud read errors after switching devices or clearing the cache. [#17](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/17)
5. Added support for selecting one or more save files so backup, restore, and sync only process the chosen files. [#18](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/18)
6. Preserved rule mappings in existing backups and sync archives so historical files remain safe to restore after editing save rules. [#18](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/18)
